title: A faster decay constant
hook: Change decay constant and predict expected activity.
misconception: expected activity stays fixed when decay constant doubles.
objective: Apply activity = λN to compare expected activity when decay constant changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With a radioactive population with fixed number of undecayed nuclei, activity = λN. When decay constant doubles, expected activity becomes 2 times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model activity = λN; scaling exponent 1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider a radioactive population with fixed number of undecayed nuclei, with a nonzero initial result. If decay constant triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on expected activity?
recall.why: Apply activity = λN under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 3.
